advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.summary: Builds a profile of your interests so advertisers can target you, often across many sites.
advertising.advice: Turn on Safari's “Hide IP Address from Trackers” and review ad personalisation in the services you use.

social.title: Social
social.summary: Lets a social network see which pages you visit, even if you never tap its buttons.
social.advice: Log out of social accounts while browsing, and keep Safari's cross-site tracking prevention on.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.summary: Counts visits and measures how people use the site. Usually the least invasive kind of tracking.
analytics.advice: Generally low risk. A content blocker can remove it if you prefer.

session_replay.title: Session replay
session_replay.summary: Records taps, scrolls and sometimes what you type so the site can replay your visit.
session_replay.advice: Avoid entering sensitive details on sites that record sessions.

fingerprinting.title: Fingerprinting
fingerprinting.summary: Identifies your device from its traits (screen, fonts, hardware) without needing cookies.
fingerprinting.advice: Keep Safari's advanced fingerprinting protection on; it limits what these scripts can read.
